## Apple's words

- **2.3.3 — Screenshots on App Store Connect show the app in use.** "App screenshots on the App Store must show the actual app in use, and not merely the title art, login page, or splash screen." Check: `screenshots_show_app` — 2.3.3 — judged on what App Store Connect holds (screenshot_audit.py).
- **2.1(a) — Launches on iOS 27, iPhone and iPad.** "We were unable to review the app because it crashed on launch. ... iPhone 17 Pro Max, iOS 27.0. ... apps that may be downloaded onto iPad devices should function as expected for iPad users." Check: `launches_ios27_iphone_ipad` — 2.1(a) — the binary adopts UIScene, and a build launched on both device families.
- **4 — Sign-in and registration happen inside the app.** "The user is taken to the default web browser to sign in or register for an account, which provides a poor user experience." Check: `sign_in_inside_app` — 4 — sign-in and registration must not leave for the default browser.
- **2.1(b) / 3.1.1 — In-app purchases are configured and submitted with the app.** "We are unable to complete the review of the app because one or more of the In-App Purchase products have not been submitted for review." Check: `iap_submitted_with_app` — 2.1(b) / 3.1.1 — products the binary sells must be configured and submittable.
- **2.1 / 5.1.2 — Tracking prompt appears when tracking is declared.** "The app uses the AppTrackingTransparency framework, but we are unable to locate the App Tracking Transparency permission request." Check: `att_prompt_when_tracking` — 2.1 / 5.1.2 — an app that asks for tracking must show the prompt before tracking.
- **2.1 (automated) — VPN questions answered when the binary links NetworkExtension.** "An automated analysis indicates the app contains VPN functionality. ... If the app does not have VPN features, reply to this message to confirm and include this clarification in the App Review Information section." Check: `vpn_statement` — Automated VPN analysis — a binary that links NetworkExtension needs a written answer.
- **5.1.1(v) — In-app account deletion when the app creates accounts.** "Account registration, login, and account deletion flows. Account deletion is required in apps that support account creation." Check: `account_deletion_in_app` — 5.1.1(v) — 'Account deletion is required in apps that support account creation.'
- **1.2 — User-generated content has reporting and blocking.** "Any user-generated content, including the required content reporting and blocking mechanisms." Check: `ugc_report_and_block` — 1.2 — 'Any user-generated content, including the required content reporting and blocking mechanisms.'
- **2.1 — Screen recording on a physical device is on file.** "A screen recording captured on a physical device, running the latest operating system, demonstrating the app's functionality. The recording must begin with launching the app and show the typical user flow." Check: `recording_on_file` — 2.1 item 1 — a screen recording on a physical device running the latest iOS.
